import ExploreMore from '@components/ExploreMore.astro';

Fieldkit gives survey teams one place to design forms, push them to devices, and get the answers back — including from places with no signal.
The Fieldkit SDKs provide official Python and TypeScript interfaces for everything the dashboard does.

### Quick Start

Collect your first submission in five minutes. If you work with an AI assistant, our [LLM context files](/docs/getting-started#context-files-for-ai-assistants) help it write Fieldkit code.

#### 1. Get Your API Key

- Open the Fieldkit [Dashboard](https://app.fieldkit.example/dashboard).
- Create a new [API key](https://app.fieldkit.example/dashboard/keys). Copy it straight away,
it won't be shown again.

#### 2. Install the SDK

<Tabs syncKey="language">
  <TabItem label="Python" icon="seti:python">
  ```bash
  pip install fieldkit
  ```
  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="TypeScript" icon="seti:typescript">
  ```bash
  npm install @fieldkit/sdk
  ```
  </TabItem>
</Tabs>

#### 3. Register a device and send a submission

<Tabs syncKey="language">
<TabItem label="Python" icon="seti:python">
```python
from fieldkit import Fieldkit, FieldkitConfig

fk = Fieldkit(FieldkitConfig(api_key="YOUR_API_KEY"))

device = fk.devices.register(name="tablet-07")
survey = fk.surveys.get("water-quality-2025")

submission = device.submit(survey.id, {"site": "W-114", "ph": 7.2})
print(submission.id)
```
</TabItem>
<TabItem label="TypeScript" icon="seti:typescript">
```typescript
import { Fieldkit } from '@fieldkit/sdk'

const fk = new Fieldkit({ apiKey: 'YOUR_API_KEY' })

const device = await fk.devices.register({ name: 'tablet-07' })
const survey = await fk.surveys.get('water-quality-2025')

const submission = await device.submit(survey.id, { site: 'W-114', ph: 7.2 })
console.log(submission.id)
```
</TabItem>
</Tabs>

:::tip
Fieldkit also runs without the SDK. Every operation in this documentation is available from the [CLI](/docs/tools/cli) and the [REST API](/docs/tools/api).
:::
